stem:
Study the timeline and answer the question that follows.

Timeline of the Historical Development of the _____?_____ Movement

1785 The Quakers helped to found the New York Manumission Society.

1831 William Lloyd Garrison published The Liberator.

1847 Frederick Douglass founded the North Star.

1852 Harriet Beecher Stowe published Uncle Tom's Cabin.
instruction: Which word correctly replaces the question mark in the title of this timeline?
visual_elements: timeline with dates and events, arrow pointing down, question mark in title
